items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: speaking of Tony Perenti, for instance, Tony was a very fine person. I always liked Tony, and no doubt he'd remember me.

ctx.x: Were many of the guys in it from New Orleans?

Yes, there were three or four of them from New Orleans. But just like I say, I'm the world's voice on remembering all the names. If you mention a name, maybe I can give you his life history. But just to think of his name at a time like this, to broach me with something, why, to ask me to – I'd have to go in a corner in a dark room maybe for about two or three months to sit down and write all these memoirs. But if you have somebody with you to – like you reminded me of some people – speaking of Tony Perenti, for…
Where was Aunt Lotta from? Was he from New Orleans?
